mastery.task: Accept a two-character prefix and a number string; output a code only when the final code has exactly five characters. Test a shorter input.
mastery.hint: Create fullCode = prefix + "-" + number; use a length check on fullCode.
mastery.answer: If prefix="CS" and number="27", fullCode="CS-27" has length 5 and is accepted. If number="7", length 4 and it is rejected. State why string length, not numerical value, matters.
